summary: The repaired comparator authenticates each of the five hybrid owner exchanges against the frozen dense ownership stride, world size, FP32 shapes and numels, and exact per-update placement before normalization. The prior arbitrary-gather false PASS and the expanded missing/extra/malformed/order/ordinary-gather matrix now fail closed.
request_finalization_requirements: A later finalizer must bind each immutable request to the exact reviewed core and verifier-receipt commits, while the Operator supplies the final request-bearing checkout HEAD and request/authorization SHA256 as external literals. Candidate, prepare, observer, hybrid/ordinary gate source, comparator, model-checker, launcher, guard, and runtime hashes must be exact; no self-derived or pending literal may remain executable.

Each arm must retain its exact source, G0/G1/G2 mode, seed 42, world size 4, LNC2, five-update argv, trn21 identity, unique initially absent remote/output/report/cache paths, compiler environment, disk floors, and one private process group.

Each request must state an independently reviewed outer timeout sufficient for compilation plus the 1800-second in-process ceiling and must enforce bounded process-group TERM/KILL/reap/quiescence before immutable artifact hashing.

Only G0 may be finalized first. G1 must remain non-executable until the exact G0 archive and clean postflight are retrieved, hashed, committed, and bound; G2 must likewise wait for exact authenticated G1 evidence.

Native evidence is complete only if the authenticated archives produce comparator PASS and model-check PASS. This package PASS does not authorize hardware execution, full A1 adoption, submission, checkpoint pruning, or cache cleanup.
